title: Stop Generating the Code You Already Have: Chimera Shared Edit Programs for Faster Long-Context Code Editing
description: Reproducible paper artifacts, figures, and summary benchmark data for Chimera shared edit programs, a representation-level acceleration approach for long-context code-editing inference. On 50 deterministic LongCodeBench-derived 100K-context file-edit episodes, Chimera improves validated artifact throughput by 1.78x over normal vLLM unified diff and by 1.43x over an MTP-enabled unified-diff baseline.
